
REPAIR-WORK-UNITS
Repair work unit data integrity issues

WHEN TO USE
  Use when validate-work-units reports issues that need fixing, such as broken references or invalid data.

USAGE
  fspec repair-work-units [options]

OPTIONS
  --dry-run
    Show what would be repaired without making changes

EXAMPLES
  1. Repair all issues
  $ fspec repair-work-units
  ✓ Repaired 3 work units
  - Fixed broken dependency: AUTH-001 → AUTH-999 (deleted)
  - Reset invalid status: UI-002

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec validate-work-units

NOTES
  • Use --dry-run first to preview changes
  • Creates backup before modifying
